title: MIAX Futures Exchange - Bunge Chicago, LLC Approved as Clearing Member
raw_text:
MIAX Futures — Clearing Alert, Technical Alert — MIAX Futures Exchange - Bunge Chicago, LLC Approved as Clearing Member
Clearing Alert, Technical Alert MIAX Futures August 31, 2026 | 05:28 PM MIAX Futures Exchange - Bunge Chicago, LLC Approved as Clearing Member MIAX Futures is pleased to announce that Bunge Chicago, LLC has been approved as a Clearing Member (MIAX Futures Clearing code = 080). For back-office processing related inquiries, the firm can be reached at the following: Bunge Chicago, LLC Back Office Operations 111 West Jackson Blvd Suite 1700 Chicago, IL 60604 Via Email: Marian.Gibson@bunge.com derivatives.compliance@bunge.com Piotr.Zubin@bunge.com Jennifer.Esquivel@bunge.com Via Phone: 312-347-1100 To view our list of MIAX Futures Clearing Members, please see our website here . For more information, please contact MIAX Futures Clearing Operations at MIAXFuturesClearingOperations@miaxglobal.com or (612) 321-7146. To learn more about MIAX Futures, please contact MIAXFutures@miaxglobal.com . To register or revise MIAX Futures Alert subscriptions, visit MIAX Email Subscriptions .
